$comment: Authoring schema for one Sigma detection-rule file (locked subset). internal/detectionpack enforces the same semantic contract at load time; contract tests keep its closed field projection synchronized. Unsupported subset constructs load as Supported=false with a reason — never silently non-matching. Product rules live in docs/security.md § Detection packs.
title: DetectionRule
description: One Sigma rule per file (.yml, single YAML document). Accepted top-level keys only; any other key ⇒ rule unsupported (unknown key). Field modifiers and condition grammar are enforced by the loader — see detection.propertyNames / description notes and the detection-pack SSOT.

title.description: Shown on the approval card and in Settings.

id.description: RFC 4122 UUID, globally unique across all packs. Hand-authored rules use v4; generated rules use deterministic v5. Duplicate id anywhere in the merged catalog ⇒ both rules unsupported.

description.description: One or two sentences; shown in Settings.

level.description: Sigma severity. Escalation is posture-aware: informational/low always inert; Light escalates critical; Balanced escalates high|critical; Strict also escalates medium.

references.description: Optional list of URLs (provenance for generated rules).

date.description: Rule creation date in Sigma ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

modified.description: Most recent material rule revision in Sigma ISO YYYY-MM-DD form.

product.description: Pinned. Any other product ⇒ rule unsupported.

service.description: tool_exec = pre-exec ask subject; egress_observed = CONNECT hold subject. Any other service ⇒ unsupported.

logsource.description: Closed pair only. A rule may reference only the event fields of its declared service; cross-source fields ⇒ unsupported (unknown field).

condition.description: Boolean expression over selection names. Grammar (or loosest, then and, then not): expr := orExpr; orExpr := andExpr ("or" andExpr)*; andExpr := notExpr ("and" notExpr)*; notExpr := "not" notExpr | primary; primary := "(" expr ")" | "1 of " selectorGlob | "all of " selectorGlob | selectionName; selectorGlob := "them" | IDENT "*". Aggregation (|), near, and timeframe ⇒ unsupported.

detection.description: ≥1 named selection plus condition. Selection names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; unknown names in condition ⇒ unsupported.

propertyNames.description: Field key form: <Field>[|<modifier>...]. Bare field = exact case-insensitive equality.

selection.description:
Map of field matchers. Every entry must match (AND). A list value matches any element (OR) unless |all is present. Values compared as strings; all comparisons case-insensitive except |re.

Closed field sets are machine-listed in x-paintedwolf-fields-by-service and contract-checked against internal/detectionpack.SupportedFields. Unknown field ⇒ unsupported.

Field modifiers (exhaustive allowlist): (none), contains, startswith, endswith, re, all. |all combines only with contains/startswith/endswith (list must match all elements). |re is Go RE2, case-sensitive unless the pattern begins with (?i); compile failure ⇒ unsupported.

Rejected modifiers (rule loads unsupported): base64, base64offset, utf16, wide, cidr, expand, windash, fieldref, cased, lt, gt, lte, gte, exists — and any other name.

fieldValue.description: Scalar string or list of strings. Booleans/numbers are not used; compare as strings at match time.
